folded.id: amegbetɔ|ƒe|ablɔɖevinyenye ŋu kpeɖoɖzinya

spans.text: AMEGBETƆ ƑE ABLƆƉEVINYENYE ŊU KPEƉOƉZINYA

Esi woɖo kpe edzi be, ehiã be se nadzɔ Amegbetɔ ƒe Ablɔɖevinyenye ŋu Kpeɖodzinya la ŋu, be ameteteɖeto kple funyafunyawɔwɔ ame magawɔe be ame aɖeke nayi eɖokui ta ʋli gei la to aglãdzedze me o ŋuti la,

Esi Xexeme Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo ɖe adzɔgbe le woƒe Ɖoɖo si te wode asie la me be, to Amegbetɔ ƒe ablɔɖevinyenye ŋu Kpeɖodzinya me la, amegbetɔ ɖesiaɖe, eɖanye nyɔnu alo ŋutsu o, ƒe gomekpɔkpɔ sɔ eye wokpɔ mɔ be to esia me la, hadomegbenɔnɔ azɔ ɖe ŋgɔ, ablɔɖe asu amesiame si wu tsã eye agbenɔnɔ nadze edzi nyuie na amesiame wu tsã ta la,

folded.subject: amegbetɔwo katã

spans.text: Esi woɖe dzesi kɔtɛe be, amegbetɔwo katã ƒe gomekpɔkpɔ sɔsɔe, anye gɔmeɖokpe na amegbetɔƒomea ƒe ablɔɖemenɔnɔ, nuteƒewɔwɔ kple ŋutiƒaƒa le xexeame ta la.

folded.subject: Amegbetɔwo

spans.text: Amegbetɔwo ƒe Ablɔɖevinyenye ŋu Kpeɖodzinya sia be, enye ɖoɖo si dzi mieda asi ɖo na amewo katã le xexeame godoo.

folded.id: le ŋutifafa|me|ƒe ablɔɖe mɔnukpɔkpɔ
folded.subject: le ŋutifafa

spans.text: Takpekpe kple hadede le ŋutifafa me ƒe ablɔɖe mɔnukpɔkpɔ, li na amesiame.

folded.id: le se|la|dziwɔwɔ me eye wo katã akpɔ gome le se la ƒe wo taʋiʋli me vovototomanɔmee
folded.subject: le se
folded.object: dziwɔwɔ me eye wo katã akpɔ gome le se la ƒe wo taʋiʋli me vovototomanɔmee

spans.text: Amewo katã sɔ le se la dziwɔwɔ me eye wo katã akpɔ gome le se la ƒe wo taʋiʋli me vovototomanɔmee.

folded.id: le se|la|nu
folded.subject: le se

spans.text: Woade bubu amesiame ŋu le afisiafi abe amegbetɔ ene le se la nu.

folded.id: le wɔna|sia|me o
folded.subject: le wɔna

spans.text: Esia gɔmee nye be ame aɖeke mekpɔ mɔ ado akplamatsee le wɔna sia me o.

folded.id: míele mɔkpɔkpɔ|me|be amesiame kple xexeame habɔbɔ ɖesiaɖe le afisiafi azɔ ɖe kpeɖodzinya sia nu
folded.subject: Míele mɔkpɔkpɔ

spans.text: Míele mɔkpɔkpɔ me be amesiame kple xexeame habɔbɔ ɖesiaɖe le afisiafi azɔ ɖe Kpeɖodzinya sia nu.

folded.id: mɔ aɖeke|dzi|anya nu tso ame aɖe kple ame bubuwo dome kadodonyawo ŋuti o
folded.subject: mɔ aɖeke
folded.object: anya nu tso ame aɖe kple ame bubuwo dome kadodonyawo ŋuti o

spans.text: Ame aɖeke mekpɔ mɔ ato mɔ aɖeke dzi anya nu tso ame aɖe kple ame bubuwo dome kadodonyawo ŋuti o.
Womazi ame aɖeke dzi be woanɔ habɔbɔ aɖe me o.

folded.id: mɔnukpɔkpɔ|sia|lɔ susuwɔwɔ le ame ɖokuisi le ablɔɖe me ɖe eme
folded.subject: Mɔnukpɔkpɔ
folded.object: lɔ susuwɔwɔ le ame ɖokuisi le ablɔɖe me ɖe eme

spans.text: Mɔnukpɔkpɔ sia lɔ susuwɔwɔ le ame ɖokuisi le ablɔɖe me ɖe eme.

folded.id: na adzɔgbeɖeɖe|sia|bliboe ta la
folded.subject: na adzɔgbeɖeɖe

spans.text: Esi eme kɔ ƒãa be gomekpɔkpɔ kple Ablɔɖemenɔnɔ gɔmesese tsitotsito nye nu vevitɔ wu, hena takpɔkpɔ na adzɔgbeɖeɖe sia bliboe ta la,

folded.id: na amegbetɔƒomea|ƒe|ablɔɖemenɔnɔ
folded.subject: na amegbetɔƒomea

spans.text: Esi woɖe dzesi kɔtɛe be, amegbetɔwo katã ƒe gomekpɔkpɔ sɔsɔe, anye gɔmeɖokpe na amegbetɔƒomea ƒe ablɔɖemenɔnɔ, nuteƒewɔwɔ kple ŋutiƒaƒa le xexeame ta la.

folded.id: nase kpeɖodzinya|la|gɔme eye woaxɔe
folded.subject: nase Kpeɖodzinya

spans.text: Esia awɔe be amewo nase Kpeɖodzinya la gɔme eye woaxɔe, awɔ ɖe edzi be, agbenɔnɔ natsɔ afo nyuie le Dukɔ siwo le Xexeme Duko Ƒoƒuawo ƒe Habɔbɔ me la me.

folded.id: nu aɖeke|ɖe|eŋu
folded.subject: nu aɖeke

spans.text: Womawɔ funyafunya ame, asẽ tame le eŋu, awɔ hlɔ̃nu aɖeke ɖe eŋu, ahe to nɛ ahaɖi gbɔ̃e o.

folded.id: nusi wòsubɔna|la|ŋuti le adzame alo gaglãgbe to mɔ ɖesiaɖe nu mɔxexe manɔmee
folded.subject: nusi wòsubɔna
folded.object: ŋuti le adzame alo gaglãgbe to mɔ ɖesiaɖe nu mɔxexe manɔmee

spans.text: Afia nu tso nusi wòsubɔna la ŋuti le adzame alo gaglãgbe to mɔ ɖesiaɖe nu mɔxexe manɔmee.

folded.id: ŋɔdzidodoname si|me|eye hiãkame maganye agbenɔnɔ ƒe afɔklinu na ame hahoawo o ŋuti la
folded.subject: ŋɔdzidodoname si
folded.object: eye hiãkame maganye agbenɔnɔ ƒe afɔklinu na ame hahoawo o ŋuti la

spans.text: Esi eme va kɔ ƒãa be, ablɔɖevinyenye si nye amegbetɔ ɖesiaɖe tɔ la ŋu mabumabu akpɔ gbɔe wòtso be hlɔ̃nuwɔwɔ ɖe amegbetɔƒomea ŋu va bɔ ta la, amewo ƒe dzitsinya va tsi tre ɖe nuwɔna vloe sia ŋuti ale woɖe adzɔgbe heɖoe kplikpaa be, le egbe xexe sia me la, ele be amegbetɔ nanɔ agbe le ablɔɖe me, aɖe eƒe didi agblɔ ƒaa vɔvɔ manɔmee, asubɔ nusi dzi wòxɔ se, avo tso ŋɔdzidodoname si me eye hiãkame maganye agbenɔnɔ ƒe afɔklinu na ame hahoawo o ŋuti la,

folded.id: se la|ɖe|mɔ be ame aɖe si ŋu woaɖe afɔ sia ƒomevi ɖo la
folded.subject: Se la
folded.object: mɔ be ame aɖe si ŋu woaɖe afɔ sia ƒomevi ɖo la

spans.text: Se la ɖe mɔ be ame aɖe si ŋu woaɖe afɔ sia ƒomevi ɖo la, naʋli eɖokui ta faa se la ŋudɔwɔwɔ me.

folded.id: si woatsɔ|ɖe|eŋu la me nɛ
folded.subject: si woatsɔ

spans.text: Gomekpɔkpɔ sɔsɔe le amesiame si ŋu wotsɔ nya ɖo hekplɔe yi dukɔa ƒe ʋɔnudrɔ̃ƒe, afisi ʋɔnudrɔ̃la adodoe siwo matso afia ŋkunɔ o la, nade to eƒe nyawo me ku ɖe eƒe gomekpɔkpɔ, eƒe dɔdeasiwo kple hlɔ̃nya ɖesiaɖe ƒomevi si woatsɔ ɖe eŋu la me nɛ.

folded.id: sitsoƒemɔnu kpɔkpɔ|sia|nana ame ne eva eme be wole eyome tim ɖe vodada siwo meku ɖe dunyahenyawo ŋu alo esiwo tsi tre ɖe xexeme dukɔƒoƒuawo ƒe ɖoɖowo ŋu o
folded.subject: sitsoƒemɔnu kpɔkpɔ
folded.object: nana ame ne eva eme be wole eyome tim ɖe vodada siwo meku ɖe dunyahenyawo ŋu alo esiwo tsi tre ɖe Xexeme Dukɔƒoƒuawo ƒe ɖoɖowo ŋu o

spans.text: Womagbe sitsoƒemɔnu kpɔkpɔ sia nana ame ne eva eme be wole eyome tim ɖe vodada siwo meku ɖe dunyahenyawo ŋu alo esiwo tsi tre ɖe Xexeme Dukɔƒoƒuawo ƒe ɖoɖowo ŋu o.

folded.id: to esia|me|la
folded.subject: to esia

spans.text: Esi Xexeme Dukɔ Ƒoƒuawo ɖe adzɔgbe le woƒe Ɖoɖo si te wode asie la me be, to Amegbetɔ ƒe ablɔɖevinyenye ŋu Kpeɖodzinya me la, amegbetɔ ɖesiaɖe, eɖanye nyɔnu alo ŋutsu o, ƒe gomekpɔkpɔ sɔ eye wokpɔ mɔ be to esia me la, hadomegbenɔnɔ azɔ ɖe ŋgɔ, ablɔɖe asu amesiame si wu tsã eye agbenɔnɔ nadze edzi nyuie na amesiame wu tsã ta la,

folded.id: to nuɖeɖi|me|nɛ la ta le eƒe dukɔ me alo dukɔ bubuwo ƒe se nu nenye be se ma menɔ anyi le amea ƒe vodadawɔxi o
folded.subject: to nuɖeɖi
folded.object: nɛ la ta le eƒe dukɔ me alo dukɔ bubuwo ƒe se nu nenye be se ma menɔ anyi le amea ƒe vodadawɔxi o

spans.text: Womabu ame aɖeke agɔdzelae le wɔna aɖe si to nuɖeɖi me nɛ la ta le eƒe dukɔ me alo dukɔ bubuwo ƒe se nu nenye be se ma menɔ anyi le amea ƒe vodadawɔxi o.

folded.id: ʋli gei|la|to aglãdzedze me o ŋuti la
folded.subject: ʋli gei
folded.object: to aglãdzedze me o ŋuti la

spans.text: Esi woɖo kpe edzi be, ehiã be se nadzɔ Amegbetɔ ƒe Ablɔɖevinyenye ŋu Kpeɖodzinya la ŋu, be ameteteɖeto kple funyafunyawɔwɔ ame magawɔe be ame aɖeke nayi eɖokui ta ʋli gei la to aglãdzedze me o ŋuti la,

folded.id: woakaka kpeɖodzinya|la|ɖe xɔɖeasinyigba siwo dzi ɖum dukɔ aɖewo le la hã me hena dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ
folded.subject: woakaka Kpeɖodzinya
folded.object: ɖe Xɔɖeasinyigba siwo dzi ɖum dukɔ aɖewo le la hã me hena dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ

spans.text: Wokpɔ mɔ be woakaka Kpeɖodzinya la ɖe Xɔɖeasinyigba siwo dzi ɖum dukɔ aɖewo le la hã me hena dzidzedzekpɔkpɔ.

folded.id: woakakae|ɖe|xexeame katã to efiafia kple emeɖeɖe na amewo me
folded.subject: Woakakae
folded.object: xexeame katã to efiafia kple emeɖeɖe na amewo me

spans.text: Woakakae ɖe xexeame katã to efiafia kple emeɖeɖe na amewo me.

folded.id: wɔna siawo|me|la
folded.subject: wɔna siawo

spans.text: Le wɔna siawo me la, liƒowo kura gɔ̃ hã manye mɔxenu o.
